column7: 2026-11-05: On the acme branch, the sort_keys option for dumps()/dump() must default to ON (on main/upstream it is opt-in, default off). Reason: Acme's tooling calls plain dumps() and we can't change their call sites, and their reviewers diff config files and complain about key order changing between drops. Plan: add sort_keys on main first, then bring it over to acme with the flipped default. Findings so far: writer never sorts; order follows input dicts, except literals are emitted before sub-tables/AoTs (TOML requirement), and AoT inline-vs-[[ ]] form depends on the 100-char line limit.

2026-11-05: sort_keys cherry-picked from main (e1543d3 -> d4c3f38) and default flipped to True in a follow-up (uncommitted); existing order-dependent tests now pass sort_keys=False explicitly, README updated.
